script_text: Taurus, this week the cosmos is about to shake your foundations in ways you never expected. Early in the week, Mercury forms a tense square with your ruling planet Venus, creating friction in your 2nd House of finances — Monday through Wednesday demand caution with money decisions and avoid signing contracts. The mid-week turning point arrives Thursday when Jupiter sextiles your 10th House of career, opening a powerful window for professional advancement and recognition. By Friday through Sunday, Venus trines your 5th House of romance, bringing a magnetic energy that could spark a meaningful connection or rekindle passion in an existing relationship. Your best day is Thursday because Jupiter's sextile to your career house amplifies your earning potential. Your worst day is Tuesday due to the Mercury-Venus square clouding your judgment on financial matters. This week, Taurus, let your earth element ground you — trust your instincts before making any major moves. Follow for daily updates.
